parameters.content:
## AI Lead Qualification System
Webhook -> validate -> duplicate check -> AI scoring (Groq -> OpenRouter -> Gemini -> rules) -> deterministic routing -> Google Sheets CRM -> alerts.

**Setup:** create credentials (see README), set the Google Sheet ID in both Sheets nodes, set the alert email in the Gmail node, edit BUSINESS/IDEAL_CUSTOMER in 'Build AI Prompt', thresholds in 'Finalize Score & Route'.

**Privacy:** free tiers of some providers may use prompts to improve their products. Do not send real customer PII until you've checked each provider's terms.

### AI fallback chain
Each provider response is parsed + validated. Any failure (HTTP error, 429, bad JSON, invalid enum) falls through to the next provider. If all fail, a rule-based score is used and the lead is routed to human review - leads are never dropped.
